name: SPACE MARINES: STORM SPEEDER
description:
Storm Speeder Thunderstrikes outmanoeuvre their foes at every turn, targeting vulnerable points in armour, fuel tanks, and missile hoppers to turn engines of war into raging fireballs. Just a single Thunderstrike is capable of destroying armoured breakthrough attempts, and when one is on the battlefield, few enemies are safe.

Swoop in and Perform Surgical Strikes

This multipart plastic kit builds one Storm Speeder Thunderstrike, a speedy tank hunter for your Space Marine armies in games of Warhammer 40,000. Armed with stormfury missiles, a thunderstrike las-talon and a twin Icarus rocket pod, it will make short work of your foe’s heavily armoured vehicles. Its manoeuvrability means you can get these heavy weapons exactly where you need them, when you need them.

Choose Your Target

The Storm Speeder Thunderstrike can alternatively be built as a fortification-busting Storm Speeder Hammerstrike or an infantry-shredding Storm Speeder Hailstrike.

Contents:
– 94 plastic components
– 1 Citadel 90mm Round Base
– 1 Citadel Flying Stem
– 1 Ultramarines - Vehicle Transfer Sheet
– 1 construction guide

The Ultramarines - Vehicle Transfer Sheet features 119 high-quality waterslide transfers. These include Ultramarines Chapter symbols, battlefield role identification, numerals, and more for you to decorate your miniature.

This miniature requires assembly and is supplied unpainted. We recommend:
– Citadel Tools: Super Fine Detail Cutters
– Warhammer Colour Plastic Glue
– Warhammer Colour paints
